'''Teracca Torrh''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Pathfinders/Legends|Pathfinder]] who served as a member of the [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Alliance Special Forces]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. A skilled marksman and demolitions expert, she also commanded [[Outpost Cinder]].<ref name="H&S" />
